decisions.reason: The date-selector scope extension does not change the clear-on-activation behavior. Message 238 already independently records the placeholder requirement's applicable contexts and observed failure.
Applying the reusable date selector to additional documents does not change the checklist control type or its scope.
The Board Meeting date-selector decision does not replace or otherwise modify the separately required dropdown control.
The source decision changes where the date selector applies but does not change how fillable fields must be made visible.
The existing help-label requirement already covers all control fields, and the date-selector scope extension does not change the date help text, label behavior, or label locations.
The source decision concerns reuse of date functionality and does not alter the requirement to preserve title-field formatting.
Extending the calendar-style date selector does not necessarily change the mechanism required for ordinary text placeholders.
The multiline-entry requirement is established by a separate clause in message 238 and is unaffected by the date-selector scope extension.
Reusing date functionality does not modify automatic bullet continuation when Enter is pressed.
The Board Meeting alignment issue is an independent requirement stated elsewhere in message 238; date-selector reuse does not change its alignment semantics.
The date-selector scope extension does not affect horizontal-border behavior when inserting a line after a Topic.
The continuous-text line-spacing requirement is established by a separate clause in message 238 and remains unchanged by the date-selector decision.
